title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：news　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 news 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the postman ① heard the news that no sender in the office would have recorded, and he said the hearing was the whole of the week. The ② news, meaning the report itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; news, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ item of news in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ news at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. News, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the postman said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the news was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the report. The ⑥ news, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; news, he said, is either something you hear or the only word that means both report and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ news had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ news of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of recording; news, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ news I remember is the news recorded in the list, which closed in 1998 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. ⑩ News, my mother said in 2000, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all news, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like report. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 消息；新闻（指邮局里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 消息；新闻（指那条消息本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：hear the news 听到这一条消息
D. n. 消息；新闻（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 消息之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的消息之事）
F. n. 消息；新闻（指收发清单里写到、被记载的那一条）
G. n. 消息、真相（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 真相（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: heard the news that no sender in the office would have recorded
The news, meaning the report itself and not the envelope
Every item of news in that office
the news at the far box
the news was the whole of the matter
the news had become a line in a list
The news of the whole thing

answers.why: hear the news 意为“听到这一条消息”，1991 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯记载的一条消息做了一遍。
news 意为“消息；新闻”，指那条消息本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
news 意为“消息；新闻”，指邮局里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
news 意为“消息；新闻”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
news 意为“消息、真相”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条真相就是那件事的全部。
news 意为“真相”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条消息，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
news 意为“消息；新闻”，指收发清单里写到、被记载的那一条，到 1996 年这一条成了收发清单里的一行。
news 意为“消息之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的消息之事是一处邮局和三个星期的记载。
news 意为“消息；新闻”，我记得的是收发清单里记载过的那一条，1998 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一条。
news 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，消息是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的消息。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年那位邮差听到了邮局里没有一位寄信人肯记载的一条消息，他说这一遍才是那个星期的全部。（hear the news）
那条消息，指的是那条消息本身而不是薄薄的信封，经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。（news）
那处邮局里每一件消息旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。（news）
最远那只信箱那条消息，指的是他们留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（news）
叔叔说这条真相就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那条消息。（news）
2000 年母亲说，消息是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的消息。（news）

The news at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
